d: A slender build wearing a futuristic tactical ensemble consisting of a slate-blue bodysuit under a dark grey chest plate with red accents, matching slate-blue trousers with black knee guards, and black lace-up boots. The head is completely concealed by a black hooded helmet featuring a blue glowing strip on the forehead and a dark visor. A tattered, greyish-white cape flows from the shoulders, and the hands are covered in black gloves, holding a large, matte-black precision sniper rifle. No hair, eyes, or facial features are visible.
